articles.title: Red Sox get promising Willson Contreras injury update as postseason nears
articles.description: On the verge of clinching a postseason berth for the second straight year, the Boston Red Sox have reason to be cautiously optimistic about the health of one of their best hitters.

articles.title: Roman Anthony’s big game puts Red Sox on precipice of clinching playoff bid
articles.description: With their win over the Rays, the Red Sox can now clinch a playoff berth as soon as Saturday night.

articles.title: Red Sox slugger out of lineup a day after getting hit by pitch on hand
articles.description: A day after getting hit in the hand by a pitch, one of the Red Sox’s top sluggers is out of the lineup.

articles.title: Trevor Story’s late home run helps Red Sox flip script on Rangers
articles.description: Trevor Story’s late three-run home run helped the Red Sox flip the script on the Rangers, avoiding the sweep and bringing the club within striking distance of clinching a playoff spot.

articles.title: Red Sox slugger leaves game after being hit by pitch in hand
articles.description: One of the Red Sox’s top hitters left the game on Thursday after being hit in the hand by a pitch.

articles.title: Injured Red Sox right-hander takes mound for first time since March
articles.description: After missing nearly the entire season due to injury, one of the Red Sox’s offseason additions is finally nearing a return to action.

articles.title: Red Sox held to three hits, drop series to Rangers with lifeless loss
articles.description: The Red Sox were held to three hits in Wednesday’s lifeless loss to the Rangers

articles.title: Cerullo: A father and son’s immaculate first day at Fenway Park
articles.description: Herald writer Mac Cerullo brought his son to his first Red Sox game on Sunday, and while heavy rain threatened to put a damper on the day, the Baseball Gods came through in immaculate fashion.

articles.title: Patrick Sandoval allows four runs in second, Red Sox lose opener to Rangers
articles.description: Patrick Sandoval put the Red Sox in a four-run hole early, and the offense squandered a pair of bases loaded opportunities to drop Tuesday’s opener against the Rangers.

articles.title: Red Sox dealt significant blow as top reliever’s injury turns season-ending
articles.description: The Red Sox will almost certainly be without one of their top relievers for the remainder of the regular season and any potential postseason games.

articles.title: Garrett Whitlock has ‘best friend back’ with Tanner Houck nearing Red Sox return
articles.description: Garrett Whitlock discusses with the Herald his special bond with Tanner Houck, and the excitement of Houck nearing a return to the Red Sox roster after Tommy John surgery.

articles.title: Payton Tolle joins exclusive club with immaculate inning as Red Sox beat Royals
articles.description: Payton Tolle became the first Red Sox pitcher since Pedro Martinez to throw an immaculate first inning as Boston defeated the Royals 4-1 on Sunday.

articles.title: Long-injured Red Sox pitcher feels like ‘kid in the candy store’ as potential return nears
articles.description: “To have that again — have that feeling again, have that rush again — it’s a feeling that you cannot replicate at all.”

articles.title: Red Sox activate Willson Contreras, place infielder on injured list
articles.description: One of the Red Sox’s top bats returned to the lineup for Sunday’s series finale against the Royals.

articles.title: MLB notes: Which Red Sox have case for major year-end awards?
articles.description: Which Red Sox have the best chance of taking home some of MLB’s big year-end awards? Here’s where things stand with two weeks to play.

articles.title: Ranger Suarez, Wilyer Abreu deliver to help Red Sox end skid
articles.description: Extra rest was well worth it for Ranger Suarez and Wilyer Abreu’s career year had yet another highlight as the Red Sox ended their losing skid against the Royals.
